title: The iPhone Duo’s screen repair costs make Samsung foldables look like a bargain

body: TL;DR The iPhone Duo will cost $999 to repair its inner display without AppleCare Plus. By comparison, Galaxy Z Fold 8 inner-screen repair costs less than half that amount, at $419. Other iPhone Duo repairs without AppleCare Plus can cost up to $1,499. Spending $1,999 on a foldable phone is already a pretty big financial commitment, and one you might make before considering the cost of keeping it in one piece. With the iPhone Duo launching later this month, Apple has now revealed how much it’ll cost to repair its first foldable without AppleCare Plus, and you might want to be sitting down for some of the figures. As spotted by MacRumors , Apple’s official repair estimates show that replacing a damaged inner display on the iPhone Duo will set you back a whopping $999. title: Apple targets Google Nest in major smart home expansion
summary: Apple takes aim at Google Nest with new cameras, locks, and thermostats.
body: Credit: LG TL;DR Apple has announced the Apple Home Collection, a new lineup of smart home products. The lineup includes indoor and outdoor cameras, thermostats, temperature sensors, a video doorbell, and a door lock. All of the products will become available this December, with select accessories releasing in early 2027. Apple has historically struggled to compete with the likes of Google and Amazon for smart home dominance. Despite those struggles, it’s long been reported that Apple is interested in changing that narrative, with plans for a renewed push in the category. Recently, it was rumored that the Cupertino-based firm had partnered with LG Electronics to take on this challenge. A leak from last week even provided a first glimpse at a few of the products the two were cooking up.
